documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited reported record quarterly financial performance for Q1 FY27, driven by operational efficiencies, cost discipline, and an increasing share of value-added products. Management highlighted capacity expansions across tire crushing, micronized rubber powder (MRP), recycled carbon black (rCB), tire pyrolysis oil (TPO), and construction chemicals, alongside growing international operations. The company reaffirmed its Vision 2029 goals of achieving INR1,000 crores in revenue while maintaining strong profitability and return metrics. Furthermore, management provided revenue guidance of INR670 crores to INR700 crores for FY27 and maintained an EBITDA margin outlook of 18% to 20%. Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited reported record quarterly performance for Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenues reaching Rs.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the guidelines for the current financial year for the top line are around INR670 crores to INR700-odd crores.
guidance.quote: Yes. So I think we have reiterated the guidelines for this current financial year is somewhere around INR670 crores to INR700-odd crores on the top line side, though we wish to maintain the kind of margin profile, what we have achieved in the Q1, but to stabilize somewhere 18 plus to 20 in between as we feel is achievable.

guidance.claim: The company's long-term targets under Vision 2029 include reaching INR1,000 crores in revenue by FY29 while maintaining a 25% plus revenue CAGR, 33% plus profitability CAGR, EBITDA margins over 18%, and ROCE exceeding 30%.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain focused on delivering our Vision 2029 objectives through capacity expansions, new product development, sustainability-led investments and on expanding our global footprint, we are targeting presence across 10 locations and revenue of INR1,000 crores by FY29, while maintaining 25% plus revenue CAGR, 33% plus profitability CAGR and EBITDA margins over 18% and ROCE exceeding 30%.

guidance.claim: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve approximately 30% volume growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve ~30% volume growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18% under Vision 2029.
guidance.quote: We aim to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.

guidance.claim: Management expects approximately 20% to 25% growth in revenue in FY27 from the previous year.
guidance.quote: What I can tell you on overall revenue is we are expecting about 20% to 25% growth in revenue in FY27 from the previous year.

guidance.claim: The projected revenue for the RCB and TPO plant for FY27 is around INR50 crores to INR55 crores.
guidance.quote: So our projection for this RCB and TPO plant for the FY27 is somewhere around INR50 crores-INR55-odd crores for the FY27.

guidance.claim: Management projects revenue contribution from PCMB to be about INR75 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: But for FY '27, our projection of revenue contribution from PCMB is about INR75 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the infrastructure segment delivered revenue growth supported by increased bituminous road surfacing activity.
demand_outlook.quote: The Infrastructure segment delivered 7% revenue growth in Q1 FY27, supported by increased bituminous road surfacing activity.

demand_outlook.claim: The West Asia conflict caused temporary bitumen supply shortages and elevated prices, generating stronger demand for company bitumen as a cost-effective alternative.
demand_outlook.quote: The West Asia conflict led to temporary bitumen supply shortages and elevated prices, creating a stronger demand for our bitumen as a cost-effective alternative for road infrastructure projects.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the consumer segment was impacted in Q1 due to a sharp increase in raw material prices following the West Asia conflict and import-export disruptions.
demand_outlook.quote: The Consumer segment was impacted in quarter 1 due to a sharp increase in raw material prices following the West Asia conflict, along with import/export disruption affecting the availability of key imported raw material to the turfing industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Export volumes delivered a robust 46% year-on-year growth despite global economic headwinds, supported by a healthy order pipeline.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports volume delivered robust 46% Y-o-Y growth despite global economic headwinds, supported by a healthy order pipeline.

demand_outlook.claim: The industrial segment achieved a 20% year-on-year growth in revenue supported by a healthy order pipeline.
demand_outlook.quote: The Industrial segment achieved a strong 20% year-on-year growth in revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer segment revenue grew by 23% despite a marginal decline in volumes reflecting price correction.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumer segment revenue grew by 23% despite a marginal decline in volumes, reflecting the impact of price correction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects some reduction in the infra business during Q1 and Q2 due to lower bitumen availability.
demand_outlook.quote: One is we expect some reduction possibly in the infra business during Q1, Q2 of this year. And that is probably, it will be because of less availability of bitumen. Because of that, roadworks, I think, are generally suffering. As a result, the demand for our modifier may also suffer in Q1, Q2.

demand_outlook.claim: The industrial sector is experiencing very robust growth driven by high prices of virgin polymers.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we are seeing very robust growth in our industrial sector. That is driven by, due to these crisis, the benefit that we have seen is there is higher motivation for blending of rubber in bitumen as well as for use of recycled rubber materials in new products. It is driven by high prices of the virgin polymers.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports volume delivered a 30% year-on-year growth supported by a healthy order pipeline.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports volume delivered robust 30% Y-o-Y growth despite global economic headwinds supported by a healthy order pipeline.

demand_outlook.claim: GCC markets contributed 60% of sales for the Oman plant, with the share expected to increase to 80% by the end of Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: GCC markets contributed 60% of sales with the share expected to increase to 80% by end of Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company executed INR27 crores of capex in Q1 FY27 as part of a broader investment plan of around INR100 crores across FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: During Q1 of FY27, we have executed INR27 crores of capex as part of our broader investment plan of around INR100 crores across FY27 and '28, strengthening our growth and operational capabilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY '27, increasing the company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 tons per annum, which it is our belief is the largest capacity of MRP in the world.

capex_expansion.claim: The tire pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trials in Q1 FY27 and is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 of FY '27, and it is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 of FY '27 with operations stabilizing by Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Land has been allocated to the company in Saudi Arabia for a proposed 24,000 tons per annum recycling facility.
capex_expansion.quote: In Saudi Arabia, land has been allocated to the company for a proposed facility of 24,000 tons per annum by recycling facility.

capex_expansion.claim: Rooftop solar plants were successfully commissioned at the Gummidipoondi and Varle facilities in June 2026 and July 2026 respectively.
capex_expansion.quote: We have successfully commissioned rooftop solar plants at our Gummidipoondi, Tamil Nadu facility of 999 kilowatt power in June '26 and at our Varle, Maharashtra facility of 2,218 kilowatt power in July 2026, further strengthening our renewable energy footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27, increasing the Company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed Rs. 27 Cr of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned approximately Rs. 100 Cr investment over FY27-FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Completed Rs. 27 Cr. of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned ~Rs. 100 Cr. investment over FY27–FY28.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional capacity of 12,000 TPA at Gannaur, Haryana has been commissioned in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Additional capacity of 12,000 TPA at Gannaur (Sonipat), Haryana, has been commissioned in Q1FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons in FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: We continue to strengthen our processing capabilities during FY26 and expanded our tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred capital expenditure of over INR100 crores during FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term growth strategy, we incurred capital expenditure of over INR100 crores during FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: Management has earmarked INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28. So over next 2 years, another INR100 crores of capex is foreseen by us.

capex_expansion.claim: The polymer compounding facility capacity in Haryana is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The Varale plant has reached a capacity utilization of 80%.
capex_expansion.quote: The Varale plant, the newest of our plants, has now reached capacity utilization of 80%.

margins_costs.claim: During the quarter, the company achieved record financial performance with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores, PAT surpassing INR20 crores, EBITDA margins over 21%, and PAT margins over 13% on both standalone and consolidated bases.
margins_costs.quote: During the quarter, we achieved record financial performance with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores, PAT surpassing INR20 crores, EBITDA margins of over 21% and PAT margins of more than 13% on both stand-alone and consolidated basis.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the gross margin expansion resulted from a combination of more efficient raw material costs and higher realizations from value-added product sales.
margins_costs.quote: That gross margin expansion has happened by a combination of both more efficient raw material costs as well as higher realization due to value-added product sales.

margins_costs.claim: Renewable energy contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Renewable energy (Solar Power) has contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.
margins_costs.quote: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. (South Africa) and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. (Saudi Arabia) reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.

margins_costs.claim: Tinna Rubber delivered robust EBITDA margins of over 17% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: FY26 was another year of strong execution for Tinna Rubber, despite geopolitical uncertainties and a dynamic operating environment, we achieved record tire processing volumes and delivered robust EBITDA margins of over 17%.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA and PAT margins expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps to 17.2% and 10% respectively.
margins_costs.quote: On a standalone basis, revenue remained largely stable at INR533 crores, while EBITDA and PAT margin expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps, respectively to 17.2% and 10%, reflecting our strong operational performance and sustained efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis, EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1%.
margins_costs.quote: On a console basis, EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1%, while revenue and PAT grew marginally by 8% and 9%, respectively.

margins_costs.claim: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuation, crude oil volatility, and elevated polymer prices.
margins_costs.quote: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuation, crude oil volatility and elevated polymer prices driven by the Middle East crisis.

margins_costs.claim: Oman plant performance was impacted by higher raw material costs and export disruptions from geopolitical tensions.
margins_costs.quote: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs during the year and export disruptions arising from geopolitical tensions in Middle East during the last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Solar capacity was increased by more than 3x to 4.48 megawatt, with nearly 50% of power requirements expected from renewables.
margins_costs.quote: During FY26, we significantly expanded our renewable energy footprint increasing solar capacity by more than 3x from 1.23 megawatt to 4.48 megawatt. Nearly 50% of our power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards, supporting both our ESG objectives and cost efficiency efforts.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a 15,000 tons rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: The company also secured a 15,000 tons of rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Tire crushing operations in India maintained a capacity utilization of 88%, while operations in Oman recorded 78% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: Tire fishing operations remained resilient in Q1 FY27 with capacity utilization at a healthy 88% in India and 78% in Oman.

orders_capacity.claim: Secured a 15,000 MT rubberized bitumen processing order, scheduled for execution during FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Secured a 15,000 MT rubberized bitumen processing order, scheduled for execution during FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Tinna achieved all-time high tire processing volume in FY26 with capacity utilization at 90% for India operations and 85% for Oman.
orders_capacity.quote: Tinna achieved all-time high tire processing volume in FY26 with capacity utilization remaining strong at 90% for India operation and 85% for Oman.

orders_capacity.claim: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum due to an increase in capacity and utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: The PCMB division operated at 40% capacity utilization during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: The division operating at 40% capacity utilization during the year provides significant headroom for growth.

orders_capacity.claim: The Oman plant operated at 85% capacity utilization in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Turning to our international project updates. The Oman plant operated at 85% capacity utilization in FY26, generating a revenue of approximately INR30 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to March 31, 2026, was fully monetized within Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to 31st March 2026 was fully monetized within Q1 FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs. 5 Cr. was allocated to R&D for FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 5 Cr. was allocated to R&D for FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our commitment to delivering sustainable value to our shareholders, I am pleased to inform the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised approximately INR78 crores through a QIP in Q1 FY26, which are now fully deployed.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q1 FY26, the company successfully raised approximately INR78 crores through a QIP, attracting participation from leading institutional investors like ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, JM Financial Mutual Fund and Bank of India Mutual Fund. These proceeds are now fully deployed.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt declined by 10% to INR121 crores in FY26 from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Balance sheet strength improved in FY26 with debt declining 10% to INR121 crores from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow from operating activities grew by 60% to INR57 crores during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: The company generated healthy cash flow from operating activities, which grew by 60% to INR57 crores during the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in relatively subdued volumes.
risks_headwinds.quote: India recorded a strong 35% Y-o-Y growth in tire fishing volumes, while operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in relatively subdued volumes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Profitability in recent quarters had been impacted by elevated raw material costs and the ongoing Middle East crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: While profitability had been impacted in the recent quarters by elevated raw material costs and the ongoing Middle East crisis, the implementation of corrective measures, including raw material import into Oman has led to a meaningful recovery in margins and overall profitability during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management has prudently revised the project implementation timeline in Saudi Arabia in light of evolving geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia and the GCC region.
risks_headwinds.quote: Management has prudently revised the project implementation timeline in light of evolving geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia and the GCC region, as ongoing supply chain and logistics disruptions continue to impact the broader industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Performance in TP Buildtech was affected by volatility in crude oil, polymer prices, and currency movements.
risks_headwinds.quote: TP Buildtech delivered revenue of INR75 crores and EBITDA of INR6 crores with margin temporarily affected by volatility in crude oil, polymer prices and currency movements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Oman plant performance was impacted by export disruptions arising from Middle East geopolitical tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs during the year and export disruptions arising from geopolitical tensions in Middle East during the last quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Commencement of capital works for the Saudi Arabia plant was delayed due to Middle East tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, due to the Middle East tensions, we thought it prudent to delay the commencement of the capital works and we are closely monitoring the situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Roadworks and modifier demand may suffer in Q1 and Q2 due to lower bitumen availability.
risks_headwinds.quote: And that is probably, it will be because of less availability of bitumen. Because of that, roadworks, I think, are generally suffering. As a result, the demand for our modifier may also suffer in Q1, Q2.

management_commitments.claim: The company renewed its commitment to innovation by allocating INR5 crores towards research and development in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We had mentioned in the past, and we are renewing our commitment to innovation by allocating INR5 crores towards research and development in FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY '27, increasing the company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 tons per annum, which it is our belief is the largest capacity of MRP in the world.

management_commitments.claim: The tire pyrolysis oil facility at Varle is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 of FY27 with operations stabilizing by Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 of FY '27, and it is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 of FY '27 with operations stabilizing by Q3 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Recovered Carbon Black production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Recovered Carbon Black (rCB) production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Transition of customers for steel abrasives distribution will start from Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Transition of customers will start from Q4FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management has earmarked INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28. So over next 2 years, another INR100 crores of capex is foreseen by us.

management_commitments.claim: Nearly 50% of power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: Nearly 50% of our power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards, supporting both our ESG objectives and cost efficiency efforts.

management_commitments.claim: The contribution from the PCMB business is expected to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

management_commitments.claim: The polymer compounding facility in Haryana is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: TPO production is expected to stabilize by the end of Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The TPO production is expected to stabilize by the end of Q1 FY27, while trial productions of the rCB plant is scheduled to begin in Q2 FY27 and we expect both the plants to be in full operation by Q3 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
